description:
The raw file is the request body (application/octet-stream, streamed, at most 2 GiB); there is no JSON body. The name query parameter sets the stored file name when it is a valid backup name, else one is made from the backup. A name that is taken gets a suffix, and an uploaded file is never kept as an automatic or scheduled one. The header is checked, the contents are not: open the file with POST /backups/{name}/inspect. Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: not-a-backup, invalid-archive, newer-format, too-large (413).

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file name to store the upload under, for example npmpro-backup-npmpro-20261117-093000.npmpro; ignored when it is not a valid backup name.

requestBody.description: The backup file, as raw bytes
